headline: Binance Covers 90% of Losses Following Multi-Billion Dollar Hack
summary: Binance stated it has used its own funds to cover 90% of losses resulting from a record $6.3 billion cyber attack, with the remaining 10% in less liquid tokens.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and major security breaches can impact digital asset market confidence and liquidity.
why_moved: Reassurance that the majority of stolen funds were recovered helped mitigate broader panic in crypto markets.
